pages.text: Use any $(l)Bubba Star$() (Lesser, regular or Celestial) on a hive to switch its bees between calm and busy. The star isn't used up.$(br2)$(l)Calm$() (the default): bees fly like vanilla bees, wander a little and stay inside twice as long.
$(l)Busy$(): bees fly faster, go straight back to flowers they know and spend half as long inside. Every rate in this book is for busy hives.
